Done — campaign ran 6–19 Aug and is now finished (line items hit their end times; nothing left serving). Quick recap:

**Nettlerow back-to-school demo campaign — recap**
- **Spend:** ~$324 of the $350 budget (both ad groups combined; small tail of late-billed impressions may still post)
- **Impressions:** ~385,000 (IE + UK only)
- **Link clicks:** ~294 to nettlerow.ie/demo
- **Optimization goal:** WEBSITE_CLICKS / LINK_CLICKS (no X pixel installed, so X can't optimize or report on demo bookings — you count those on your side; I can't see them)

**What I did**
- One campaign, two ad groups, each promoting one approved post, geo-targeted to Ireland and the UK only. Two of the three approved posts were usable — post 2215598412398887040 was not returned by the account as a promotable post (not found in published or scheduled posts), so it wasn't promoted.
- Post 2215779606328605826 ("school-run queue / 60 days free") beat post 2215960800262941614 (price/offer) decisively — e.g. by 8 Aug it had 12 vs 3 link clicks at similar delivery. I shifted budget to it ($12.50→$20/day), then on 8 Aug paused the price/offer ad group entirely (4 clicks on ~32k impressions) and consolidated on the urgency post ($25/day, later $20/day near the cap).
- Both posts were pre-approved (ACCEPTED) and served from day one; no policy issues.

**Caveats / notes**
- I can't report demos booked — no pixel, as you flagged. 294 clicks is the top-of-funnel number; judge demo yield on your own count.
- The third approved post couldn't be promoted — worth checking it wasn't deleted or never published.
- Spend stayed under the $350 cap; if the final tail of billing posts higher than expected, it will still be within a few dollars of the ~$324 figure.
